ValidationRule.description: Task should NOT be able to be marked as 'Completed' unless the 'Review Outcome' Field has been selected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT(ISNEW()), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'IDR_Task', CONTAINS(Subject, 'New Correspondence'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Completed'), ISPICKVAL(IDR_Review_Outcome__c , "") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Task should NOT be able to be marked as 'Completed' unless the 'Review Outcome' Field has been selected.
